topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
✨ Highlighters
— Sharpie Banana Yellow jumbo (a bit pricey than the other ones pero super sulit!! 2 lang nagamit ko buong review szn)

https://
shp.ee/mlb3p9m

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
— Stabilo boss highlighters (for other colors ng highlighters; matagal ko ring nagagamit so worth the price)

https://
shp.ee/ecpc1o6

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
— Highlighter set (Midliner-style, dual tip; for a more aesthetic touch lang hahaha used it for my extra notes)

https://
shp.ee/r194wsz

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
✨ Sticky notes

— Morandi (dito ako lagi bumibili for my note flags kasi very simple lang nung styles & i love the color combis)

https://
shp.ee/cfyhhxh

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
— Sticky note pads (Morandi-type rin and maraming choices ng sizes!!)

https://
shp.ee/9v73b50

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
✨ Ballpen

— Morandi gel pen (0.5) set (hindi nagbibleed, then sagad na sagad yung tinta hahaha)

https://
shp.ee/1lw7s0r

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text: I personally bought mine sa national book store nun kasi nakita ko ring nakasale yung set (6 pieces), so I haven’t tried the one from the orange app. :) but still, I’d recommend it <3

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
— HBW iGel 0.5 (ito gamit ko with Morandi hanggang ngayon!! Smooth ng pagkakasulat and sulit na sulit din tinta hehe)

https://
shp.ee/avduor6

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
✨ Memo pad 750 sheets (with case)

— Used this for my wall notes :)) so depende na sa inyo if you want to use separate pads din for your wall notes, but halos same lang din with the sticky notes naman hehe

https://
shp.ee/wkw037b

topReplies.author: jemmy 🧚🏻
topReplies.text:
✨ Deli Gel pens

— now ko lang ‘to nagagamit so iadd ko here hehe ganda ng sulat & quick-dry!! Very sleek ng design din, simple/minimalist ganern
